title: ICE in Denver: Stand with our Immigrants
description:
ICE has ramped up their presence at the immigration court at the
Federal Building at 1961 Stout St. in Denver.

A family of three was detained on Thursday, and an individual was detained on Friday. Denver IPTs (Immigrant Protection Teams) are coordinating with other local groups to respond to this escalation.

People are gathering outside the immigration court, holding signs, to protest the actions of immigration judges and ICE agents. The Denver IPTs will also be handing out information to those entering the building for immigration court. 

This peaceful presence will be every morning (Monday-Friday) from 8 AM to 10:30 AM at 1961 Stout St. Folks are welcome to show up whenever they can, and stay as long as they are able.

We hope some of you and your friends and family members will be able to show up for our immigrant neighbors in this way in these troubled times.

title: Statewide Webinar: Supreme Court Review in U.S. v Skrmetti
description:
The U.S. Supreme Court should soon be issuing their decision in U.S. v Skrmetti, a key case involving individual states' efforts to ban essential, evidence-based, gender affirming health care for young people. 

In anticipation of this decision, we at Equality Michigan, along with our partners at the ACLU of Michigan, are offering this statewide virtual webinar to discuss the details and breadth of the decision, as well as how it does and does not impact Michiganders. 

The conversation will feature Emme Zanotti, Equality Michigan's Senior Director of Movement Building & Political Affairs; and Jay Kaplan, the ACLU of Michigan's LGBTQ+ Rights Project Staff Attorney.

There will be a Q&A portion of the webinar, where panelists can answer questions related both to the case, and to some other relevant issues impacting Michigan's LGBTQ+ community. 

In the event that a decision comes sooner in June, we may move this meeting up to more urgently answer your questions and try to address your concerns.

title: SPRINGFIELD Labor Day! Vote to Modernize Our Union!
description:
# Union Strong for the Future: Modernizing Our Union Constitution & Bylaws 

No matter what we look like, where we come from, or what job we do, working people deserve dignity, safety, and a voice on the job by organizing their union. But powerful interests try to divide us and weaken our ability to stand up for what we need. That’s why we’re taking action to ensure efficient use of our resources while strengthening and protecting our local Union — by updating SEIU Local 49’s Constitution and Bylaws. These updates will make our Union more modern, more inclusive, and more transparent — so we can keep fighting and winning together. 

A lot has changed in the last 15 years. Think about it: 15 years ago, there was no Zoom, most of us didn’t have smartphones, and many of our strongest union leaders today hadn’t even started their jobs yet. Just like our workplaces and organizing have evolved, it’s time for our union’s rules to catch up. We’re also updating outdated language to make sure everyone in our union is respected, no matter our race, gender, or where we were born, so that every member is recognized and respected for who they are.  

One important note with all these changes: The proposed amendments to the bylaws do not increase member dues; in fact, this ensures no one will pay initiation fees and dues at the same time! 

Our SEIU Local 49 Executive Board voted unanimously to approve these updates. Now we need to hear from you. This is your union — and your voice matters. That’s why we’re asking all members to vote on these changes.

We'll have a booth set up where you can cast your vote. There will be grilling, pop & water, live music,  and more! Bring a side dish to share. NOTE: No alcohol allowed.

title: SPRINGFIELD ¡Día del Trabajo! ¡Vote para modernizar nuestra unión!
description:
# Unión Fuerte para el Futuro: Modernizando nuestra Constitución y Reglamentos de la unión

No importa cómo nos veamos, de dónde vengamos o qué trabajo hagamos, las personas trabajadoras merecen dignidad, seguridad y una voz en el trabajo al organizar su unión. Pero los intereses poderosos intentan dividirnos y debilitar nuestra capacidad de luchar por lo que necesitamos. Por eso estamos tomando medidas para usar nuestros recursos de manera eficiente, al mismo tiempo que fortalecemos y protegemos nuestra Unión local — actualizando la Constitución y Reglamentos de SEIU Local 49. Estas actualizaciones harán que nuestra Unión sea más moderna, más inclusiva y transparente — para que podamos seguir luchando y ganando juntos.

Mucho ha cambiado en los últimos 15 años. Piénselo: hace 15 años no existía Zoom, la mayoría de nosotros no teníamos teléfonos inteligentes, y muchas de nuestras y nuestros líderes sindicales más fuertes de hoy ni siquiera habían empezado sus trabajos. Así como han evolucionado nuestros lugares de trabajo y nuestra organización, también es hora de que nuestras reglas sindicales se pongan al día. También estamos actualizando lenguaje anticuado para asegurar que todas las personas en nuestra unión sean respetadas, sin importar nuestra raza, género o lugar de nacimiento, para que cada miembro sea reconocido y respetado por quien es. 

Una nota importante sobre todos estos cambios: Las enmiendas propuestas a los Reglamentos no aumentan las cuotas de membresía; de hecho, esto asegura que nadie pague la cuota de iniciación y las cuotas al mismo tiempo.

Nuestra Mesa Directiva de SEIU Local 49 votó por unanimidad para aprobar estas actualizaciones. Ahora necesitamos escuchar su voz. Esta es su unión — y su voz importa. Por eso estamos pidiendo a todos los miembros que voten sobre estos cambios.

Tendremos un puesto donde podrá emitir su voto. Habrá asado, refrescos y agua, música en vivo ¡y más! Traiga un platillo para compartir. 

**NOTA:** No se permite alcohol.

La votación comienza a las 12:30 p. m., pero la celebración del Día del Trabajo será de 12:00 p. m. a 3:30 p. m. ¡Nos vemos allí!
